items: Create, read and change work items.
items block: Mark an item blocked, with a reason.
items cancel: Cancel an item that will never resume.
items create: Create a work item with its spec.
items dependency: Add, list, change and remove item dependencies.
items dependency add: Record that one item waits on another.
items dependency list: List the dependencies of an item.
items dependency remove: Remove a dependency between two items.
items dependency update: Change how one item waits on another.
items detail get: Read an item's status, workflow and lane facts.
items freeze: Park an item in the Freezer, keeping its status.
items get: Read an item's fields and sections.
items github-link: Change or remove an item's GitHub issue link.
items github-sync: Sync an item or its tasks to GitHub issues.
items list: List items, filtered by status, priority and more.
items merge: Correct the record of how an item merged.
items merge provenance: Correct the record of how an item merged.
items merge-provenance: Correct the record of how an item merged.
items merge-provenance operator-correct: Correct an item's recorded merge time or pull request.
items overview: List item rows for the roster view.
items overview list: List items for the roster, with search and paging.
items progress: Read and add item Progress Log entries.
items progress log: Read and add item Progress Log entries.
items progress log append: Add a dated entry to an item's Progress Log.
items progress-log: Read and add item Progress Log entries.
items progress-log append: Add a dated entry to an item's Progress Log.
items scalar update: Change one item field, such as status or priority.
items search: Find items by keywords in their text.
items section: Read, write and delete named sections of an item.
items section delete: Delete a named section from an item.
items section get: Read one named section of an item.
items section upsert: Create or replace a stored item section, like Progress Log.
items structured: Edit an item's long text fields, such as spec or plan.
items structured field: Edit an item's long text fields, such as spec or plan.
items structured field replace: Replace the whole text of an item field.
items structured-field: Edit an item's long text fields, such as spec or plan.
items structured-field append-addendum: Add a new headed block to an item text field.
items structured-field replace: Replace the whole text of an item field.
items structured-field section-append: Add a dated entry under a section of an item.
items structured-field section-upsert: Create or replace a section of an item text field.
items thaw: Return a frozen item to the board.
items unblock: Clear an item's blocked flag and reason.
